result.summary: 本文提出 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，可生成 1080p 高清视频及同步音频，并支持指令式视频编辑与基于用户图像的个性化视频生成 [abstract]。其最大的视频生成模型为 30B 参数 Transformer，最大上下文长度 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的视频 [abstract]。模型在文本到视频合成、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频生成和文本到音频生成等多个任务上取得新的最优结果 [abstract]。作者还公开了两个基准 Movie Gen Video Bench 与 Movie Gen Audio Bench，并详细披露架构、训练、推理与实验设置，希望加速媒体生成模型的研究 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合与预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间，而非 LLM 的文本输出空间 [S1.p1]。作者希望构建一组媒体生成基础模型，能够原生生成高保真图像、视频和音频，并具备编辑与个性化视频的能力 [S1.p1]。此外，作者指出当前缺乏可靠的媒体生成模型评测手段，因此公开两个基准以支持未来评测 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
in this paper we focus on media – image, video, audio – as the output space.
Movie Gen models can natively generate high fidelity images, video, and audio while also possessing the abilities to edit and personalize the videos
To enable future benchmarking, we publicly release two benchmarks —Movie Gen Video Bench (Section 3.5.2), Movie Gen Audio Bench (Section 6.3.2).

method.text: Movie Gen 包含两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像与文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频/文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。视频模型在时间自编码器（TAE）学习到的时空压缩潜空间中进行生成，使用 Flow Matching 训练目标，并采用基于 LLaMa3 的 Transformer 骨干 [S3.p2][S3.p3]。音频模型同样采用 Flow Matching 与 DiT 架构，条件输入包括视频、音频上下文和文本 [S6.SS1.p1]。个性化与编辑能力通过后训练获得：个性化以参考人脸图像为条件，编辑则在没有监督视频编辑数据的情况下通过多阶段训练实现 [S2.p3][S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: Movie Gen Video. A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
we perform generation in a spatio-temporally compressed latent space.
We use the Flow Matching training objective to train our generative model.
which include using the LLaMa3 backbone architecture for the joint image-video generation model
We adopt the flow-matching based generative models and the diffusion transformer (DiT) model architecture.
Personalization enables the video generation model to condition on text as well as an image of a person to generate a video featuring the chosen person.
we introduce Movie Gen Edit, a model that achieves state-of-the-art results in video editing, and outline our approach for training it without any supervised video editing data.

experiments.text: 视频模型在约 1 亿视频-文本对和约 10 亿图像-文本对上预训练，并经过多阶段训练与高质量视频监督微调 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.p1]。评测使用作者公开的 Movie Gen Video Bench（1003 条提示）以及 Movie Gen Video Bench-Mini（381 条提示）进行人类 A/B 评估 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1][S3.SS6.SSS2.p1]。音频模型在约 100 万小时音频上预训练，并在电影级数据与高质量音频数据上微调，评测覆盖 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 及新提出的 Movie Gen Audio Bench 等 [S2.p2][S6.SS2.SSS3.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p3]。编辑模型在 TGVE+ 与作者新提出的 Movie Gen Edit Bench 上评测 [S5.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our pre-training dataset consists of $\mathcal{O}$ (100)M video-text pairs and $\mathcal{O}$ (1)B image-text pairs.
we improve the motion and aesthetic quality of the generated videos by finetuning the pre-trained model on a small finetuning set of selected videos.
which consists of 1003 prompts that cover all the different testing aspects summarized above.
termed Movie Gen Video Bench-Mini, and report results on text faithfulness and overall quality
We pre-train the model on $\mathcal{O}$ (1)M hours of audio
First is the cinematic split, which includes clips that are professionally produced that often contains both diegetic and non-diegetic sounds (ambient and theme music).
This includes VGGSound, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen3, and our proposed Movie Gen Audio Bench.
We evaluate the capabilities of our model against two main video editing benchmarks.

findings.text: 在文本到视频生成上，Movie Gen Video 在整体质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3（净胜率 35.02%）和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 为中等净胜（8.23%），与 Kling1.5 持平（3.87%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感与美学上，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，对 OpenAI Sora 在真实感上显著净胜 11.62% [S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。音频方面，Movie Gen Audio 在所有指标上大幅优于基线，例如在生成视频上整体质量净胜 31.3% 至 91.0% [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3]。编辑方面，在 TGVE+ 基准上人类评估者偏好 Movie Gen Edit 超过当时最优的 EVE 达 74% [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 $\sigma$) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics, with 48.49%, 61.83% and 37.09% net win rates on realness, respectively.
Compared to OpenAI Sora, Movie Gen Video has a significant win on realness with 11.62% net win rate beyond $2\sigma$
with 33.8% to 72.8% on synchronization, 27.5% to 82.2% on correctness for all videos, and 31.3% to 91.0% on overall quality for generated videos.
We demonstrate that human annotators prefer Movie Gen Edit more than 74% of the time when compared to the previous state-of-the-art on the TGVE+ benchmark.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在伪影 [S8.p2]。生成音频在动作密集（如踢踏舞）、视觉上较小或被遮挡（如脚步声）或需要更细粒度视觉理解（如识别吉他和弦）时有时不同步，且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。作者还指出，使用人类评估定义客观标准仍然困难，人类评估可能受个人偏见、背景等因素影响 [S8.p2]。此外，模型分别针对视频和音频训练，联合生成这些模态是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。

evidence.quote: artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense ( e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded ( e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
